name: Siding
summary: Siding, soffit, fascia and exterior trim repairs or replacement to protect and improve residential and commercial properties.

faqs.question: When should damaged siding be replaced instead of repaired?
faqs.answer: Replacement may be recommended when damage is widespread, materials are deteriorated or matching repairs would not provide a durable result.

faqs.question: Can siding damage lead to water intrusion?
faqs.answer: Yes. Open joints, cracks and missing sections can allow moisture behind the exterior finish and should be evaluated promptly.
